message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is a comprehensive, detailed breakdown of the **PlayBeat Admin Panel** design:

### 1. Overall Layout
The interface follows a classic **sidebar + header + dashboard grid** layout:
*   **Left Sidebar:** Fixed-width (approx. 260px), full-height navigation rail with a distinct brand area at the top and user profile at the bottom.
*   **Top Header:** Sticky horizontal bar spanning the remaining width, containing search, global actions, and user controls.
*   **Main Content Area:** A responsive CSS Grid layout (appears to be 3 or 4 columns) with generous padding. Content is organized into "cards" or "widgets" of varying sizes.

### 2. Color Scheme
This is a **Dark Mode / Mixed Theme** with high-contrast neon accents.
*   **Primary Background:** Deep navy/black (`#0B1120` or `#0f172a`).
*   **Sidebar Background:** Slightly lighter dark blue (`#111827` or `#1e293b`) with a subtle gradient overlay on the left edge.
*   **Card Backgrounds:** Dark translucent panels (`rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)` to `rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.4)`).
*   **Accent Colors:**
    *   **Gold/Yellow (`#FACC15`):** Primary action color (Dashboard active state, Quick Add button, chart lines, "Total Orders" card glow).
    *   **Electric Blue (`#3B82F6`):** Secondary accent ("Total Revenue" card, "Completed" status, active tabs).
    *   **Purple/Violet (`#A855F7`):** Tertiary accent ("Total Products" card).
    *   **Teal/Green (`#10B981`):** Success/Positive metrics ("Total Customers", "Healthy" status, growth percentages).
*   **Text Colors:**
    *   Primary Text: White (`#FFFFFF`) or very light gray (`#F8FAFC`).
    *   Secondary/Muted Text: Slate gray (`#94A3B8` or `#64748B`).

### 3. Sidebar Menu Items & Icons
The sidebar uses a clean, icon-left/text-right format with section headers in small uppercase tracking-wide text.

*   **Logo Area:** Large "PlayBeat" logo with a play-button icon inside a yellow circle, tagline "DIGITAL PVT LTD".
*   **Active Item:** **Dashboard** (Home icon) — Highlighted with a **gold/yellow gradient background**, rounded corners, and bold white text. A subtle waveform graphic decorates the right side of the active pill.
*   **Section: WEBSITE & ANALYTICS**
    *   Website Builder CMS (Grid/Layout icon) →
    *   Analytics & Traffic (Bar chart icon)
*   **Section: COMMERCE & INVENTORY**
    *   Orders & Fulfillment (Shopping cart icon) — **Badge: "2"** (Yellow)
    *   Catalog Products (Cube/Box icon) — **Badge: "17"** (Yellow)
    *   Digital License Vault (Key/Lock icon)
    *   Subscriptions (Refresh/Arrow icon)
    *   Discounts & Coupons (Tag icon)
*   **Section: CUSTOMERS & SUPPORT**
    *   Customer Accounts (User icon) — **Badge: "248"** (Yellow)
    *   Support Tickets (Chat bubble icon) — **Badge: "6"** (Yellow)
*   **Section: IPTV & SERVICES**
    *   IPTV M3U Servers (TV icon) — **Badge: "3"** (Yellow)
*   **Section: MARKETING & INTEGRATIONS**
    *   Marketing Campaigns (Megaphone icon)
    *   Email Templates (Envelope icon)
    *   Integrations (Puzzle piece/Settings icon)
*   **Section: SYSTEM**
    *   Settings (Gear icon)
    *   Activity Logs (Document/List icon)
*   **Bottom Profile Card:**
    *   Avatar: Circle with "P" initial (Gold background).
    *   Name: **PlayBeat Digital**
    *   Role: Pro Plan • Online (Green dot indicator).

### 4. Header Elements
A sleek, semi-transparent bar separating sidebar from content.
*   **Left:**
    *   **Collapse Button:** Small circular button with an "X" or arrow icon (dark background).
    *   **Search Bar:** Wide, rounded search input with placeholder "Search products, orders, customers..." and keyboard shortcut hint "Ctrl + K". Background is slightly lighter than the page.
*   **Right (Action Cluster):**
    *   **Storefront Button:** Outlined/glassmorphic button with cart icon + text "Storefront".
    *   **Quick Add Button:** Solid **gold/yellow** button with plus icon + "Quick Add" text (bold, black text).
    *   **Icon Buttons:** Mail/Message icon (with notification dot?), Bell/Notification icon (with red badge "3").
    *   **User Profile Dropdown:** Circular avatar with "P", name "PlayBeat Admin", role "Administrator", and chevron down.

### 5. Main Content Area - Widgets & Data

**A. Welcome Banner (Full Width)**
*   **Left:** Waving hand emoji (👋), Headline "Welcome back, PlayBeat Admin!" (Bold, large), Subtext "Here's what's happening with your business today." (Muted).
*   **Right:** Date/Time display "Thursday, 21 Aug 2026 09:42 PM (SGT)" with clock icon, followed by three tab buttons: "Today", "**This Week**" (Active, Blue filled), "This Month", and a Settings gear icon.

**B. Stats Cards (Row of 4)**
Each card has a subtle colored border-left or glow effect matching its theme, with a large icon in a circle on the right.
1.  **Total Revenue (Blue theme):** Icon: Dollar sign `$`. Value: **Rs 44,800**. Subtext: "↑ +18.4% vs last 7 days" (Green). Mini sparkline chart showing upward trend.
2.  **Total Orders (Gold theme):** Icon: Shopping Cart. Value: **2**. Subtext: "↑ +12.1% vs last week". Mini gold sparkline.
3.  **Total Products (Purple theme):** Icon: Box/Package. Value: **17**. Subtext: "↑ +6.3% new this week". Mini purple sparkline.
4.  **Total Customers (Green theme):** Icon: Users/People. Value: **248**. Subtext: "↑ +9.7% vs last week". Mini green sparkline.

**C. Revenue & Sales Trend (Large Chart - Left Column)**
*   **Header:** Fire emoji + "Revenue & Sales Trend". Dropdown: "Last 14 Days".
*   **Tabs:** "Revenue" (Active, Blue pill), "Orders", "Customers".
*   **Big Metric:** "Rs 44,800" with "+18.4% growth" (Green). Tooltip-style box showing "Today Rs 44,800".
*   **Chart:** Line chart (Gold/Yellow line) with data points (circles). X-axis: Dates (Aug 08 - Aug 21). Y-axis: Values (0 - 60K). Gridlines are subtle horizontal lines.

**D. Order Breakdown (Donut Chart - Middle Column)**
*   **Header:** Box icon + "Order Breakdown". Dropdown: "This Week".
*   **Chart:** Large donut chart (Blue and Gold segments).
*   **Center Text:** Big number "**2**" with "Total Orders" below.
*   **Legend:**
    *   Blue dot: Completed — 1 (50%)
    *   Teal dot: Processing — 1 (50%)
    *   Gold dot: Pending — 0 (0%)

**E. Traffic Sources (List - Right Column)**
*   **Header:** Bar chart icon + "Traffic Sources". Dropdown: "This Week".
*   **List Items (Progress bar style):**
    *   Direct / URL: **52%** (1,492) — Blue progress bar
    *   TikTok Leads & Pixel: **28%** (832) — Purple/Pink progress bar
    *   Google Search: **14%** (481) — Green progress bar
    *   Affiliate Referrals: **6%** (172) — Yellow progress bar
*   **Footer:** "View Full Analytics →" button (full width, outlined/dark).

**F. Top Selling Products (Bottom Left)**
*   **Header:** Crown icon + "Top Selling Products". Dropdown: "This Week".
*   **List:** Product thumbnail (square), Title, Sales count (with fire icon for hot items), Price, Rank (#1, #2, #3 in gold badges).
    1.  PlayStation Gift Card - $50 (USA) | Sales: 12 🔥 | Rs 24,000 | #1
    2.  PlayStation Gift Card - $25 (USA) | Sales: 8 🔥 | Rs 14,000 | #2
    3.  Netflix Premium 1 Month | Sales: 5 | Rs 6,800 | #3
*   **Footer:** "View All Products →"

**G. Recent Orders (Bottom Middle)**
*   **Header:** List icon + "Recent Orders". Link: "View All →".
*   **Table-like list:**
    *   Order ID (#PB-00024), Customer (John Doe), Amount (Rs 2,499), Status (**Completed** - Green pill).
    *   Order ID (#PB-00023), Customer (Sarah Smith), Amount (Rs 1,499), Status (**Completed**).
    *   Order ID (#PB-00022), Customer (Mike Johnson), Amount (Rs 1,299), Status (**Completed**).

**H. System Health (Bottom Right)**
*   **Header:** Heartbeat/EKG icon + "System Health". Badge: "All Systems Operational" (Green).
*   **Gauge Chart:** Circular progress ring (Green) showing **100% Healthy** with EKG line animation inside.
*   **Status List:** Checkmark (green) + Service Name + Status (Online/Green text):
    *   Web Server — Online
    *   Database — Online
    *   Payment Gateway — Online
    *   Email Service — Online
    *   IPTV Services — Online

**I. Quick Actions (Full Width Bottom Bar)**
*   **Label:** "Quick Actions" + subtext "Everything you need, one click away".
*   **Buttons (Dark background, rounded, icon + text):**
    *   ➕ Add Product (Green tint)
    *   📢 Send Campaign (Purple tint)
    *   🏪 View Store (Blue tint)
    *   🛒 Manage Orders (Orange tint)
    *   🎧 Support Tickets (Cyan tint)

**J. Promo Banner (Bottom Right Corner)**
*   **Design:** Gradient banner (Dark blue to Black) with rocket illustration.
*   **Content:** PlayBeat logo, "Boost Your Sales with PlayBeat Tools!", Subtext about campaigns, **"Launch Campaign →"** (Gold button).

### 6. Typography Style
*   **Font Family:** Clean sans-serif (likely **Inter**, **Poppins**, or **Plus Jakarta Sans**).
*   **Headings:** Bold (700), White, relatively large (24px-32px for main title, 18px-20px for card headers).
*   **Data/Numbers:** Extra Bold (800), Large (28px-36px for stats), often monospaced or tabular for alignment.
*   **Body Text:** Regular (400) or Medium (500), Light gray/Slate.
*   **Labels/Captions:** Small (12px), Uppercase, Letter-spacing wide (0.05em-0.1em), Muted color.

### 7. Spacing and Visual Style
*   **Rounded Corners:** Heavy use of border-radius. Cards have `rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl` (approx 16px-24px). Buttons are fully rounded (`rounded-full`) or heavily rounded (`rounded-xl`).
*   **Shadows:** Soft, colored drop shadows matching the card's accent color (e.g., blue card has blue glow/shadow). This creates a "neon" or "glassmorphism" effect.
*   **Borders:** Very subtle, 1px solid borders in a color slightly lighter than the background (`border-white/5` or `border-white/10`).
*   **Spacing:** Generous padding inside cards (20px-24px). Gap between grid items is approximately 20px-24px.
*   **Visual Effects:**
    *   **Glassmorphism:** Semi-transparent backgrounds with backdrop blur (especially visible on the header and some cards).
    *   **Gradients:** The active sidebar item and "Quick Add" button use vibrant gradients (Gold to Yellow-Orange).
    *   **Glow Effects:** The stat cards have a subtle outer glow on the left edge or around icons.

### 8. Branding/Logo
*   **Main Logo:** Wordmark "**playbeat**" in lowercase, bold, custom font (slightly italicized/dynamic). The 'y' has a long tail. Above it is a circular icon containing a "play" triangle and a "beat" soundwave symbol.
*   **Tagline:** "DIGITAL PVT LTD" in tiny uppercase letters beneath the logo.
*   **Colors:** Logo uses Yellow/Gold and White primarily.
*   **Favicon:** A simple "P" inside a circle (used for user avatar too).

### 9. Buttons and Styles
*   **Primary Action (Quick Add):** Background: Linear gradient (Gold `#FACC15` to darker gold). Text: Black/Dark Gray (`#1a1a1a`). Font weight: Bold. Rounded-full. Shadow: Gold glow.
*   **Secondary/Outline (Storefront):** Border: 1px solid white/20. Background: Transparent. Text: White. Hover effect likely lightens background.
*   **Ghost/Text Buttons:** Used for "View All", "View Full Analytics". Arrow icon on right. No background, just text + icon.
*   **Status Pills (Badges):** Small, rounded-full, colored backgrounds with low opacity (e.g., Green bg with green text for "Completed", "Online").
*   **Icon Buttons (Header):** Circular, hover background (white/10), no border.

### 10. Theme
*   **Theme:** **Dark Mode with Neon Accents (Cyber/Dashboard aesthetic)**.
*   It is not pure black; it uses deep blues (`slate-900`, `blue-950`) to create depth.
*   The design feels modern, high-tech, and data-dense but organized through strict visual hierarchy and color coding.

**To recreate this exactly:** Use a framework like Tailwind CSS. Set the body background to `bg-slate-950`. Use `backdrop-blur-xl` and `bg-white/5` for card backgrounds. Implement the specific hex codes mentioned above for the glowing borders and accents. Use `lucide-react` or similar for the icons (Home, ShoppingCart, Users, BarChart3, etc.).
